name: Smooth FPS
description: Custom FPS slider (24-1440) with frame extrapolation for smooth motion above the physics rate. Physics is never changed.

fps.name: FPS
fps.description: Rendering frame rate. Physics keeps its own fixed ticks. For values above your monitor's refresh rate, turn off VSync in GD's video settings.

smoothing.name: Frame smoothing
smoothing.description: Draws the players and the camera between physics ticks so motion stays smooth at high FPS. Visual only, real positions never change.

smooth-wave-trail.name: Smooth wave trail
smooth-wave-trail.description: Also smooths the head of the wave trail. Turn this off if you get crashes or glitches while playing the wave.

mode.name: Smoothing mode
mode.description: <cy>Extrapolation</c> predicts where the player is right now (no added delay). <cy>Interpolation</c> blends between the last two ticks (up to one tick behind, never overshoots).
